key_fields.sql: select payment_type, count(*) as trips from lake.trips group by payment_type order by payment_type
key_fields.claim: The PERFECT_HASH_GROUP_BY builds a hash table for only 5 groups but still processes 495,833 rows individually; a pre-aggregated metadata cache or materialized view would avoid the scan entirely.

value.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM (SELECT payment_type FROM lake.trips GROUP BY payment_type) GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_type
value.change_summary: Added a redundant GROUP BY to force a two-phase aggregation, testing if partial aggregation reduces hash table overhead despite identical logical result.
value.risk_notes: May not improve performance in DuckDB if the optimizer flattens the subquery; functionally identical but risks identical plan if optimization is applied.
